title: From Word to World: Evaluate and Mitigate Culture Bias in LLMs via Word Association Test

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a human-centered Word Association Test (WAT) as an LLM-adaptive word prediction task. The model's predicted probability rankings for associative words are compared against human responses from four distinct cultural groups (USA, UK, Oceania, and China) using a novel Position-Weighted Recall (PWR@K) metric, supplemented by evaluations on downstream cultural benchmarks like the World Values Survey (WVS) and BLEnD.
